verdicts.reason: A keeps the circle round and has a strong two-line headline, but the GLACIER wordmark floats off-axis instead of lining up with the headline. The circle presses against the top edge, the CTA nearly touches the bottom edge and the two badge pills almost touch each other. B lines up the wordmark, headline and body copy well, but the circle is stretched into an ellipse that gets cut off at the top and bottom. The SOLSTICE label on the can is illegible, and all the content sits in the upper half, leaving a dead band of empty space underneath.
